annotation.title_clean: Council Implementing Decision of 16 December 2014 authorising Croatia to apply a tax exemption to gas oil used to operate machinery in humanitarian demining in accordance with Article 19 of Directive 2003/96/EC
annotation.title_en: Council Implementing Decision of 16 December 2014 authorising Croatia to apply a tax exemption to gas oil used to operate machinery in humanitarian demining in accordance with Article 19 of Directive 2003/96/EC
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 363/150
annotation.summary_en: EU Council Implementing Decision authorising Croatia to exempt from energy taxation the gas oil used in accredited special-purpose humanitarian demining machinery, for six years under Article 19 of Directive 2003/96/EC. It is a tax measure, not about AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Croatia authorised to exempt gas oil used in humanitarian demining machinery from taxation
Limited to accredited special-purpose machines built for clearing mined areas
Applies to all demining operators in Croatia, without favouring any operator
Takes effect on notification and expires after six years
Without prejudice to EU State aid rules
